boundaries.source: Sign in if asked; the page then shows {example}. Copy the token. EA issues no application keys, so this is the same credential Playnite uses. It is short-lived — re-paste when a sync says it expired. If EA answers {provider_message} it is blocking the sign-in itself, usually because of a VPN or unfamiliar IP — turn the VPN off for this one sign-in and try again.

Sign in there; the page ends up showing {example}. Copy the code. If Epic asks you to accept terms first, do that and it continues. The code is single-use and expires in minutes, so paste it straight away -- ROMarr swaps it for a refresh token and never asks again.
Signed in to Blizzard, that page is a plain JSON list of your games. Copy the whole document and paste it -- it is data, not a credential, so nothing secret is stored.
Signed in to GOG, that page shows {example} near the start. Paste that username. Your profile's games list must be public ({settings_url}) — that is the whole credential, there is no token.
Signed in to playstation.com, this page shows {example}. Copy the value between the quotes.
